audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with its own prose: whys[2] says 'Galio edges Level 3' and whys[4] says 'Galio spikes at 6', but win[2]/win[4] and phases[2].side/phases[4].side were set to Gragas/Skill.
audit.why: The packet levelChart lists Galio at index 2 and index 4, and the mirror audit (galio__gragas) also gives Galio Level 3 and Level 6. Both layers must state the same owner.
audit.corrected: win[2] and phases[2].side -> Galio; win[4] and phases[4].side -> Galio, with phases[2].why and phases[4].why rewritten to state why (charged Shield of Durand taunt at 3; Hero's Entrance plus taunt at 6). Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer spike text referenced 'his key tool' and 'your ultimate' generically with no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Real numbers make the advice actionable: Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140, Explosive Cask 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d now carry the real cooldowns; phases[4].why names Hero's Entrance at 180s.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad said a whiffed E is '13 seconds', and the trade lines used slot letters instead of ability names; the decisive interaction (Body Slam dashing into a charging Shield of Durand taunt) was never stated.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 (14s at rank 1, not 13). Shield of Durand is a charged taunt at 275 range: Gragas closing to point-blank with Body Slam is exactly what it wants, and being taunted freezes the W-auto/Q-detonate follow-up.
audit.corrected: tradeGood/tradeBad/dosFull/dontsFull now name Barrel Roll, Drunken Rage, Body Slam and Explosive Cask and state the Body-Slam-into-charging-taunt interaction with the correct 14s figure.

audit.why: Justice Punch carries a derived 'terrain' flag in the kit file, but Riot's description is only a backstep-and-charge knockup with no wall creation. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: No 'Galio cuts your retreat with terrain' claim written to any field.

edits.after: Poke with Barrel Roll and commit only after Justice Punch is spent — it is down 11s at rank 1. Keep the wave on your half of the lane.

edits.after: Barrel Roll from fog, Drunken Rage as he answers, Body Slam only once Justice Punch is spent (11s).

edits.after: Body Slam into a charging Shield of Durand — a whiffed E is 14s of standing there with no escape.

edits.after: Body Slam into a charging Shield of Durand — a whiffed E is 14s of standing there with no escape.

edits.after: His dash-knockup engage, down 11s at rank 1. Commit only after it whiffs or is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Galio must walk into your engage range.

edits.after: Galio spikes at 6: Hero's Entrance (180s) plus a charged taunt eats your Body Slam–W–Q mid-combo. Save Explosive Cask to scatter his landing.

notes: Level-chart flips (rows 2 and 4, both layers) are proposed as one atomic group. Rows 5-6 left as Gragas: the 53.19% win rate and the Riftmaker spike text support Gragas there, even though the packet chart lists Skill — flagged rather than flipped. Justice Punch's derived 'terrain' flag is a tooltip-parse misfire (Riot's text is a backstep-and-charge knockup only); no terrain/retreat-cut claim written. suspectNames flagged "Shield of Durand's" in late — that is the correct ability name in possessive form, a false positive.
